author: Xbox
description:
Requiem for the dead. Nightmare for the living.

Resident Evil Requiem is now available for pre-order! Experience terrifying survival horror with FBI analyst Grace Ashcroft, and dive into pulse-pounding action with legendary agent Leon S. Kennedy. Both of their journeys and unique gameplay styles intertwine into a heart-stopping, emotional experience that will chill you to your core.
 
A new era of survival horror begins when Resident Evil Requiem launches February 27, 2026 for Xbox Series X|S.

The "DEAD OR ALIVE" series returns with more striking and intense battles!

DEAD OR ALIVE 6 Last Round will be slugging its way onto Xbox on June 25, 2026. This is the definitive version of DEAD OR ALIVE 6, which was first released back in 2019, and this new version will release simultaneously with both standard and free to play editions.
